mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 250, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 250, policy misalignment between low rates and high inflation triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 250, or rank correlation between interaction signal and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes of HOUST > 1200 and GDPC1 > 17000, strong housing demand and GDP growth signal economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 AND GDPC1 > 17000, or rank correlation between regime condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that triggers inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or rank correlation between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher INDPRO level indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 5-year median, or rank correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5, or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL monthly change and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO < 100, tight labor market combined with slowing industrial production triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100, or rank correlation between interaction signal and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
